qa_pairs.question: My NovaBook 14 charging port failed without any physical damage, but I am already past the return window. Will I get a refund, and does a replacement restart my warranty?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: The warranty covers defects in materials or workmanship under normal use. Examples include a charging port that fails without physical damage, a display that develops non-impact-related lines, or a HomeHub radio that stops connecting to supported devices. A customer inside the return window may choose an eligible return; after that window, a covered defect follows the repair process in `07_repair_and_technical_support.md`. Warranty service may result in repair, replacement with an equivalent new or refurbished unit, or refund when the first two remedies are not reasonable. OrbitTech chooses the remedy after diagnosis. A replacement device does not restart a new 24-month warranty.
